aboutText: Velaqua Plumbing has been servicing South Melbourne and surrounding suburbs for over 20 years. As a licensed and experienced local plumber, Dan and the team provide honest upfront pricing and fast, reliable responses for all plumbing needs. From emergency callouts to scheduled repairs, we deliver quality guaranteed workmanship across South Melbourne, Albert Park, Southbank, Port Melbourne, and the CBD. Your trusted 24/7 emergency plumber.
servicesText: Velaqua Plumbing offers a complete range of residential and commercial plumbing services across South Melbourne. From urgent emergency repairs to scheduled maintenance, our licensed experts deliver quality workmanship every time.

services.title: 24/7 Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Round-the-clock emergency plumbing service with a $0 callout fee. When disaster strikes, we respond fast across South Melbourne and surrounds.

services.title: Blocked Drains
services.desc: Expert blocked drain clearing using modern equipment. We diagnose and fix blockages in toilets, sinks, and stormwater drains quickly.

services.title: Hot Water Installation
services.desc: Professional hot water system installation and repair. We service all major brands and ensure reliable hot water for your South Melbourne home.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repairs
services.desc: Fast identification and repair of leaking pipes, taps, and fixtures. We stop water waste and prevent costly property damage.

services.title: Tap & Toilet Repairs
services.desc: Reliable tap repairs, toilet maintenance, and fixture replacements. Honest pricing from the start with experienced local plumbers.

services.title: Gas Fitting
services.desc: Licensed gas fitting services for cooktops, heaters, and hot water systems. Safe, compliant gas work across South Melbourne.

reviews.text: Daniel replaced our tempering valve so we could enjoy hot showers again. He was knowledgeable, professional, and courteous, completing the job within the agreed timeframe. I would highly recommend Velaqua Plumbing to anyone in South Melbourne.
reviews.name: August Valentine

reviews.text: Daniel did an amazing job on my blocked drain. Nothing was too much trouble and he was totally professional in his work. We called last minute and he responded quickly with a competitive price. Highly recommended for any plumbing issue.
reviews.name: Michael Sioukas

reviews.text: Daniel is very friendly and skilled in his trade with a keen eye for detail. He fixed a particularly complex kitchen tap with relative ease. I have found a plumber for life and highly recommend Velaqua to anyone seeking a skilled plumber.
reviews.name: Rose Grabovac
